ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity (white) to 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white regions cover the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous border along the trailing edge and fluke tips. A significant vertical, low-intensity mottled region extends from the median notch downward toward the base.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Open V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 110 degrees and a moderate depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased irregularity and pixel-amplitude at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve transitioning from the median notch to a sharp posterior sweep at the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, low-intensity circular pixel clusters detected on the lower-central region near the peduncle and sparsely across the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, roughly horizontal linear pixel disruptions on the right lobe; one prominent thin horizontal line on the lower-left quadrant.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel linear rake marks visible on the right lobe; irregular pigmentation erosion and scarring localized at the fluke tips and median notch border.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dendritic or 'ink-bleed' pattern of dark pigment extending ventrally from the central notch area.
